title: Assessing Radiation Induced Stress Relaxation in Strained Epitaxial Films with HREBSD
content: Lattice mismatch between different layers of microelectronic devices typically results in considerable stresses. These stresses are a potential source of failure in microelectronic devices, but stresses can also be an integral part of device performance, for example, boosting the drive current in field effect transistors [1]. Radiation induced damage can relieve these stresses, affecting the reliability of these devices when exposed to radiation [2]. This study will assess the radiation-induced relaxation in simple layered thin films exposed to an ion beam rather than actual devices because stress characterization at the length scale of modern electronic devices can be problematic. TEM can characterize modern devices, but only with destructive sample prep that relieves much of the stress. This data can be used to calibrate models of radiation induced relaxation in actual devices.
